```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


library("dplyr") # data cleaning and handling
library("modelsummary") # outputting results where needed
library(srvyr) # used for logit regressions with complex survey designs
library(svyVGAM) # used for PPO regressions with complex survey designs 
 
# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()

# Construct input file path
input_2024 <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$output_file_2024_1year
)

input_2019 <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$output_file_2019_1year
)

input_means <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$outout_file_ACS_1year_means
)

input_dis <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$output_file_ACS_1year_IncDis
)


## independent variables to be used in the regessions below.  This means you only
## need to update them here.

x_vector <- ("HHSize + ChildPresent + SeniorPresent + AGE + LF + SEX + HHSize*ChildPresent ") 

stopifnot(file.exists(input_2019))
stopifnot(file.exists(input_2024))
stopifnot(file.exists(input_means))
stopifnot(file.exists(input_dis))

```

## load the 2024 data
 
```{r}

ACS_1year_2024 <- read.csv(file.path(input_2024)) ## loads 2024 data

ACS_1year_means <-read.csv(file.path(input_means))

ACS_1year_dis <-read.csv(file.path(input_dis))

Weighted_IPUMS <-as_survey(ACS_1year_2024, id=CLUSTER,
                           weights=HHWT,
                           strata=STRATA,
                           nest=TRUE)

## This is to loop over the different logit models in R and produce 1 result for each

y_vector <-  names(ACS_1year_2024 %>% select(num_range("Inc", 1:14))) # vector of Inc to loop over

## the for loop using lapply, takes in the vector of Inc varriables, combines
## the formula of x and y varriables, then runs them through the svglm function
## saves the results in the models object.  
models <- lapply(y_vector, function(y) {
  
  logitformula <- reformulate(termlabels = x_vector, response = y)
  
  svyglm(logitformula, design = Weighted_IPUMS, family =  binomial (link = "logit"))
})

## adds the Inc# as the name of the lists stored in models, easier to call
## e.g. if you want the results for Inc1 you can call models$Inc1 

names(models) <- y_vector

# Generate predicted probabilities
pred_matrix <- sapply(models, function(mod) {
  predict(mod,
          newdata = ACS_1year_means,
          type = "response")
})

pred_matrix_2024 <- as.data.frame(pred_matrix) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = ACS_1year_means$YEAR) %>%
  relocate(YEAR)

# Sum probabilities across income categories for each observation
rowSums(pred_matrix)


# multinomial logit
mnl <- svy_vglm(
  as.formula(paste("IncCat ~", x_vector)),
  design = Weighted_IPUMS,
  family = multinomial(refLevel = "Inc1")
)


mlogit_predictions <- predict(mnl,
                             newdata = ACS_1year_means,
                             type="response"
)


# Reorder columns numerically (Inc1, Inc2, ..., Inc14)
ordered_cols <- str_sort(colnames(mlogit_predictions), numeric = TRUE)
mlogit_predictions <- mlogit_predictions[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]

mlogit_predictions_2024 <- as.data.frame(mlogit_predictions) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = ACS_1year_means$YEAR) %>%
  relocate(YEAR)

rm(mnl, pred_matrix , models, y_vector, mlogit_predictions)



```


## load the 2019 data
 
```{r}

ACS_1year_2019 <- read.csv(file.path(input_2019)) ## loads 2024 data

ACS_1year_means <-read.csv(file.path(input_means))

ACS_1year_dis <-read.csv(file.path(input_dis))

Weighted_IPUMS <-as_survey(ACS_1year_2019, id=CLUSTER,
                           weights=HHWT,
                           strata=STRATA,
                           nest=TRUE)
 


## This is to loop over the different logit models in R and produce 1 result for each

y_vector <-  names(ACS_1year_2019 %>% select(num_range("Inc", 1:14))) # vector of Inc to loop over


## the for loop using lapply, takes in the vector of Inc varriables, combines
## the formula of x and y varriables, then runs them through the svglm function
## saves the results in the models object.  
models <- lapply(y_vector, function(y) {
  
  logitformula <- reformulate(termlabels = x_vector, response = y)
  
  svyglm(logitformula, design = Weighted_IPUMS, family =  binomial (link = "logit"))
})

## adds the Inc# as the name of the lists stored in models, easier to call
## e.g. if you want the results for Inc1 you can call models$Inc1 

names(models) <- y_vector 

# Generate predicted probabilities
pred_matrix <- sapply(models, function(mod) {
  predict(mod,
          newdata = ACS_1year_means,
          type = "response")
})

# Sum probabilities across income categories for each observation
rowSums(pred_matrix)

pred_matrix_2019 <-as.data.frame(pred_matrix) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = ACS_1year_means$YEAR) %>%
  relocate(YEAR)

 
# multinomial logit
mnl <- svy_vglm(
  as.formula(paste("IncCat ~", x_vector)),
  design = Weighted_IPUMS,
  family = multinomial(refLevel = "Inc1")
)

mlogit_predictions <- predict(mnl,
                             newdata = ACS_1year_means,
                             type="response"
)


# Reorder columns numerically (Inc1, Inc2, ..., Inc14)
ordered_cols <- str_sort(colnames(mlogit_predictions), numeric = TRUE)
mlogit_predictions <- mlogit_predictions[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]




mlogit_predictions_2019 <- as.data.frame(mlogit_predictions) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = ACS_1year_means$YEAR) %>%
  relocate(YEAR)

rm(mnl, pred_matrix , models, y_vector, mlogit_predictions)

```

## Export csv for later use

```{r}


stopifnot(!is.null(cfg$paths$output_dir))

## export individual logit predictions 2024 data

# Create output directory if it does not exist
dir.create(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

years <- c("2019", "2024")

## make a list of output matrices for individual logits
pred_matrices <- list(
  `2019` = pred_matrix_2019,
  `2024` = pred_matrix_2024
)

## prediction for Multi nomial logits

mlogit_predictions <- list(
  `2019` = mlogit_predictions_2019,
  `2024` = mlogit_predictions_2024
)

## file list for export for logits
logit_files <- list(
  `2019` = cfg$Predict$output_file_logit_2019_1year,
  `2024` = cfg$Predict$output_file_logit_2024_1year
)

## file list for export for Mlogits
mult_files <- list(
  `2019` = cfg$Predict$output_file_Mult_2019_1year,
  `2024` = cfg$Predict$output_file_Mult_2024_1year
)

# uses pred_matricies but any would work
for (yr in years) {
  
  print(yr)
  
  print(cfg$paths$output_dir)
  
  print(mult_files[[yr]])
  
  # create filepath for logits 
  output_logit <- file.path(
    cfg$paths$output_dir,
    logit_files[[yr]]
  )

  # create file paths for multinomial logits
  
 output_mult <- file.path(
    cfg$paths$output_dir,
    mult_files[[yr]]
  )
 
 # write csv for logit
  write.csv(
    pred_matrices[[yr]],
    output_logit,
    row.names = FALSE
  )


# write csv for multinational logit 
  write.csv(
    mlogit_predictions[[yr]],
    output_mult,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
 #clean up the memory
rm(list = ls())
 
  
}

```
